messages:
Alex: handing over the evening bridge — I'm primary for the next 20 mins, @Raj will take primary at 19:00 UTC. quick context: p99 inference latency spike in us-east-1 since ~18:42 UTC, some 504s reported. IncidentBot: [ALERT] inference.p99 > 3.0s for model-r4 (us-east-1) :rotating_light:
IncidentBot: pager severity: HIGH. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.
DeployBot: recent rollout 18:35 UTC (model-r4 quantized v2) — rollout status: 100% traffic.
Maria: seeing connection churn on serve-nodes-03 and -04, KV cache miss rate jumped. customers hitting timeouts when KV lookup falls back to full forward pass.
Raj: coverage note — I'm covering APAC after 19:00 UTC, so Alex will be primary until then. If we need cross-region failover, flag early.
Jin: quick checklist (first actions):
- check logs on serve-nodes-03/04: `kubectl logs -f pod/serve-node-03 -n inference-prod`
- check Prometheus metrics: `curl -s http://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=inference_kv_miss_rate
`
- if KV cache thrash, follow runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback|KV cache fallback runbook>
Maria: I ran `curl https://internal-metrics:9100/metrics | grep kv_miss` — miss rate from 0.02 -> 0.42 since spike. also p50/p90 fine, only tail is affected.
Alex: mitigation plan (rapid-hitlist):
1) Short-term: enable fallback routing to model-r4-small in us-east-1 for latency-sensitive routes. Route policy ID: `route-policy:latency-fallback-01`. Use Console or run: `redwoodctl routes set --policy latency-fallback-01 --region us-east-1`
2) Warmstart workers: scale up replica count for model-r4 to pre-warm caches: `kubectl scale deploy/serve-model-r4 --replicas=10 -n inference-prod`
3) If nodes unresponsive, restart pods one at a time:```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/serve-model-r4 -n inference-prod
# wait 30s between restarts for KV warmup
```
4) If rollout was the cause, rollback to previous model: `redwoodctl models rollback model-r4 --to v1` — only do with PM/Eng approval.
Jin: added note — reduce batch size temporarily to reduce amplification of cold-KV misses: set env `BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024` on serving pods (Console -> config override).
Raj: customer impact assessment: 12 customers with elevated error rate, mostly developer and staging tenants; one mid-size customer (acme-corp) hitting 30% 504s on /v1/chat. I've flagged CS.
Maria: runbook links: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-triage|Latency triage>, <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollback|Model rollback guidelines>, <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/traffic-shift|Traffic shift playbook>.
Alex: live checks I'm doing now: tail logs for `TimeoutError` and `KVCacheEvict`, checking `node-exporter` memory for serve-nodes-03/04. If memory < 20% free, likely cache eviction thrash.
IncidentBot: incident snapshot: triggered 18:43:12 UTC, alerting group eng-oncall.
Raj: temporary coverage gap note — I'm ~10m from desk at 19:00 UTC arriving in channel then. If escalation to infra required while I'm moving, ping @Jin directly.
Jin: If we decide to do cross-region fallback: `redwoodctl traffic set --from-region us-east-1 --to-region us-west-2 --percent 30 --routes /v1/chat` — start with 10-30% to avoid spike.
Maria: I'm prepping a minimal canary of r4-small in us-east-1 to take latency-sensitive traffic. will post canary link when ready.
Alex: small operational notes for whoever takes primary:
- don't mass-restart more than 2 pods concurrently
- watch KV miss rate for 5m after each change
- annotate actions in incident ticket: INC-2026-1842
Raj: acknowledged. once Alex hands off, I'll monitor CS and customer-impact list.
Alex: handing over now to Raj (primary at 19:00 UTC). if anything flares, @Jin please escalate to infra. leaving channel open for 1h. :thumbsup:
Raj: taking primary. will keep updates here and escalate if rollback needed.
Jin: standing by — I'll coordinate infra actions if we need node-level fixes.
Maria: updating CS with status and ETA for partial mitigation (traffic shift + warmstart).
Alex: closing handoff — notes saved to incident ticket and runbook links posted. good luck team.
